palette_basis: Original production proposal; not PLUS official brand colors
shared_constraints: Use clearly volumetric stylized 3D forms, rounded edges, and contact shadows.
Keep the subject, props, background, and lighting in one consistent stylized 3D world.
Use matte clay for the mascot and furniture, restrained gloss for lenses, and translucent glass for selected products and the basket.
Use a warm rear-side key light, stable object positions, and clear caption space.
No generated text, logos, financial numbers, or company names.
Use an original product mascot rather than copying an existing character or outfit.
The five company tokens are a visual example, not verified ETF holdings.
